title: hypothesize-filters
intention: The acceptance gate for the HYPOTHESIZE brick's output, installed in the build_inspector BEFORE the hypothesize module exists. judge_hypothesize (the pure judge, one implementation) reads the packet's triage_ref berth and holds two claims: HYPOTHESIZE_COVERS_THE_RANKED — every hypothesis attaches to a piece the ranked order actually carries (verbatim), and every ranked piece carries at least one hypothesis (a covering, not a permutation — several hypotheses per piece are welcome; a piece with none is the piece whose wrong landing reds nothing); HYPOTHESIZE_FALSIFIABLE_MEASURED — every hypothesis carries its expect, its falsifier (the observation that would kill the claim), and its instrument (the measure that would be run), all non-empty, missing fields named completely in one finding. The promotion-side mouths ride the one generalized _judge_charted wrapper; the future berth door composes judge_hypothesize by identity, never the reverse.
why: Law 3 verbatim: nothing is known until measured — an unmeasured claim is a hypothesis and is LABELED as one. This stage makes the label a schema. The dated failures are claim-shaped: 2026-07-27 'logging: 0 of 13' (a claim whose instrument was a word-grep — the instrument must be NAMED so it can be challenged); 2026-07-26/27 state-reported-from-records (wrong about the world three times in one morning — expectations never checked against an instrument at all); and the proof-writing lessons (the pinned-cursor spurious red, the leak-scan coin-toss red) where the FALSIFIER was the defective part — a falsifier that fires on normal motion is as unmeasured as none. /sorted's completeness gate already refuses casting without a falsifier; this moves that prose one stage earlier and one rung down the ladder, per piece.
traces_to: Law 3 — the stage IS the law's label, made structural per piece
Law 8 — the brick that will emit hypotheses cannot shape its own acceptance; the judges are sealed before the module is born
Law 7 — missing fields are named completely in one finding (complete diagnostic on first pass)
Law 4 — /sorted's 'no falsifier, not ready' prose moves into schema physics

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth in build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py — a full covering with measured, falsifiable claims passes quiet; an uncovered ranked piece fires hypothesize_covers_the_ranked naming every uncovered piece; a hypothesis on an invented piece fires the same judge with the ranked pieces in evidence; a claim missing its falsifier or instrument fires hypothesize_falsifiable_measured naming ALL missing fields at once; a broken triage_ref chain is a loud finding; the two-mouths pin. Sealed under the tester before the module exists.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the hypothesize module shaping these judges (the inspector importing from cairn.machines.chart, or the judge defined anywhere but the inspector); the door and the promotion gate disagreeing on one packet; a filter installed here without a dated failure behind it; the coverage check passing a packet that leaves a ranked piece unhypothesized.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the hypothesize module lands under these judges (same arc); when validate lands (the hypotheses become its criteria's subjects); if a real crossing shows the falsifier/instrument split is the wrong seam (a design event).
